exr: OPEN_EXR 16-bit half, ZIP, RGB, single layer
white_reference_note: Rec709 luminance of the gray card (albedo 0.18) measured in the rendered EXRs (mean over 200 frames, eroded card mask); includes partial occlusion of the low edge of the 8deg sun disc by the bridge deck. units_note: Scene-linear Rec709 radiance as written by Cycles; Blender sun strength = irradiance (W/m2), white diffuse facing sun = S/pi
